failures.rootCause: A changed TypeScript spec file was not Prettier-formatted before push, causing CI format check failure.
failures.preventionRule: Changed TypeScript, JavaScript, JSON, Markdown, YAML, and test/spec files must be included in format validation before PR readiness can be READY.
failures.regressionTest: A changed .spec.ts file must require format validation and format failure must produce NEEDS_WORK.
